corpus.format: TSV: key<TAB>entry text, one entry per line, blank line between entries

checks.description: Key must match its entry-type pattern exactly.
Entry text must be a single line with no tabs or newlines inside.
No citation artifacts, markdown, brackets, or em dashes.
Entry must address the reader directly.

Advisory: most entries pivot with 'but' or 'though'; varied pivots ('It gets...', 'The same speed that...') are acceptable. The structure-formula LLM check is authoritative for strength+shadow presence.
Opener must be 'When the ruler of an empty {N} house lands in the {M},' with N and M matching the key (use 'sits in the {N} house' when N == M). Catches reversed-direction entries.

params.opener_template_diff: ^When the ruler of an empty {house} house lands in the {target}
params.opener_template_same: ^When the ruler of an empty {house} house sits in the {house} house

checks.description: Sign entries open with a trait statement, never with the sign name or ruler mechanics.
Word count within band for the entry type.
No verbatim clause reuse across entries. Ruler-opener template is stripped before comparison. Shared run of warn_n+ words = warning; error_n+ = error.

params.strip_prefix_pattern: ^when the ruler of an empty \w+ house (lands|sits) in the \w+( house)?

checks.description: Content must describe the key's house domain (and for ruler entries, show how it plays out in the target house's domain).

house_domains.1st: presence, first impressions, identity, body, personal initiative
house_domains.2nd: income, money, possessions, personal values, financial security
house_domains.3rd: communication, learning, siblings, neighbors, errands, short trips
house_domains.4th: home, family, roots, private life, property
house_domains.6th: daily work, routines, health, service, coworkers
house_domains.8th: shared finances, debt, taxes, inheritance, deep intimacy, transformation
house_domains.9th: higher education, travel, philosophy, publishing, law, foreign connections
house_domains.11th: friends, community, networks, causes, long-term hopes
house_domains.12th: solitude, subconscious, rest, hidden work, private healing

checks.description: Traits and shadow must match the key's sign.

sign_traits.aries: direct, fast, competitive; shadow: impatience, weak follow-through
sign_traits.taurus: steady, patient, tangible comfort; shadow: stubbornness, holding on too long
sign_traits.gemini: curious, verbal, multi-track; shadow: scattered focus, inconsistency
sign_traits.cancer: protective, feeling-led, memory-rich; shadow: scarcity fear, taking things personally
sign_traits.leo: warm, proud, expressive; shadow: needing applause, ego bruises
sign_traits.virgo: precise, analytical, helpful; shadow: perfectionism, self-criticism, anxiety
sign_traits.libra: diplomatic, aesthetic, fair; shadow: conflict avoidance, indecision
sign_traits.scorpio: intense, private, strategic; shadow: secrecy, control, suspicion
sign_traits.sagittarius: expansive, optimistic, blunt; shadow: overpromising, skipped details
sign_traits.capricorn: disciplined, responsible, long-range; shadow: over-seriousness, carrying burdens alone
sign_traits.aquarius: original, independent, objective; shadow: detachment, novelty over reliability
sign_traits.pisces: intuitive, empathetic, imaginative; shadow: vague boundaries, absorbing others' feelings

checks.description: 3-4 sentences: (1) domain/behavior opener, (2) concrete everyday manifestations with real nouns, (3) one acknowledged strength, (4) one cost framed as an adjustable habit introduced with 'but'. Exactly one strength and one shadow.
No predicted events, no deficit framing (empty never means missing), shadow is a tendency the reader can adjust, tone stays warm and non-judgmental.

scoring.warn_policy: Warnings do not fail an entry but must be listed in the judge output.
